title: Totem but Teto
description: Totem of Teto :p (custom sound and model)
body:
![banner of totem of teto](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b222209e77f7e1795abd7c99107df402afefc62_0.webp)
This resource pack change the totem of undying into teto plush :D

You can now venture the world with Teto by your side, beware she can become kinda greedy sometimes and eat all your bread, so caution if you have bread in your inventory. (this is a joke btw)
